answer: Audits are published in knoll, queued in fable, and ridge publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 10 identities per epoch. A farm of 105 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1279 identities would post 4952 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
